g.text: Saved task total field: amplitude and phase, f/f₀=1, source 1
Actual saved FEM task-world total fields from 2/2 original seeds; these are known-world fields, not inverse reconstructions or new solves.
At most 12,000 stored quadrature values per seed are shown with deterministic subsampling and no interpolation. Amplitude uses one common sampled-value scale.
